candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from NETM so any caller can execute it and overwrite balances[owner] with totalDistributed.
Delete the statement that credits totalDistributed to the owner's balance, so no balance is set by NETM.
Credit totalRemaining instead of totalDistributed to the owner's balance in NETM.
Set owner to address(0) in NETM so the distributed balance is written to balances[address(0)] instead of the caller's balance.
Delete the statement that decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender], so the allowance is never reduced by transferFrom.
Replace the allowance decrement with an assignment of _amount, so the remaining allowance is set to the transferred amount instead of reduced by it.
Change the allowance update to increase allowed[_from][msg.sender] by _amount instead of decreasing it.
